name: Bonkwif
lore: BONK’s orange Shiba face and raised brows peek out beneath WIF’s unmistakable pink knitted hat. Equal parts side-eye and soft yarn, Bonkwif keeps the pack cozy and the jokes dry.
inherited: orange Shiba face, cream muzzle and skeptical brows

name: GasKitty
lore: POPCAT’s wide-open mouth becomes the source of Fartcoin-inspired pixel puffs. GasKitty turns every surprised gasp into a mischievous little gust.
inherited: wide O-shaped mouth and white-and-brown cat face
pixel-art styling and comic gas-cloud motif

name: Boncata
lore: BONK’s orange coat, cream muzzle and skeptical brows meet POPCAT’s enormous open mouth. Boncata looks unimpressed until one spectacular gasp gives the game away.
inherited: orange Shiba coloring, cream muzzle and raised brows
cat ears and signature round open mouth

name: Purl
tagline: A knowing look. A perfectly knitted disguise.
lore: MEW’s white coat and narrow mischievous eyes meet WIF’s snug pink knitted beanie. Purl is the quiet observer of the lab, saving a sharp little joke for just the right moment.
inherited: white cat silhouette, pink ears and narrow eyes
recognizable pale pink ribbed knitted beanie

name: Acorn
lore: BONK’s orange Shiba face and cream muzzle join Peanut’s bushy squirrel tail and peanut-holding paws. Acorn stashes tiny treasures and big plans for the entire pack.
inherited: orange Shiba face, triangular ears and cream muzzle
fluffy curled squirrel tail and peanut-holding paws

name: Gulp
tagline: The tiniest hippo. The biggest reaction.
lore: POPCAT’s unmistakable O-shaped mouth and pointed cat ears meet Moo Deng’s round hippo snout, glossy gray skin and pink cheeks. Gulp makes every small surprise feel enormous.
inherited: enormous round open mouth and pointed cat ears
baby pygmy hippo snout, wet gray skin and pink cheeks
